text:
aj: quick question — we're seeing two things in staging after the latest per-model flags rollout: 1) some models read stale feature flags after a deploy, 2) the TF plan wants to recreate a ConfigMap we only expect to patch. Anyone else?
simon: seeing the same. looks like checksum annotation isn't being updated for pods that mount the cm. hostPath vs volume mount?
maria: FYI I observed the secret-syncer job touching the same namespace right before the deploy, might be a race. it rewrites secrets and we have a small k8s controller that annotates configmaps with `cfg-checksum`.
loren: can we confirm mount paths? we used to mount per-model at `/app/conf/model_flags/<model>` but recent kustomize overlay switched to `/app/conf/models` which collapses multiple CMS into one dir — could cause stale reads if app caches by filename.
aj: good catch. here's the exact `kubectl` I ran:
```
kubectl get cm model-flags-bert -n inference -o yaml
# metadata.annotations.cfg-checksum: "sha256:abc123"
```
infra-bot: CI:terraform-plan pipeline failed on `modules/k8s/configmaps` — terraform wants to replace `kubernetes_config_map.model-flags-bert` (diff: mountPath -> changed).
maria: stack trace from app logs shows `watcher: ignored change for /app/conf/models/bert.json - filename unchanged` — so controller updates contents but filename stays same, app ignores.
aj: short proposal: revert overlay to individual mountPaths per model OR change our reloader to watch file contents not filenames. which is lower risk?
simon: lower risk is change mountPath back. PR is small: kustomize patch for overlays/staging/models.yaml with per-model mounts. also add explicit annotation `reloader.stable.example.com/watch-by-content: "true"` to avoid future.
loren: +1. also need to make sure terraform doesn't destroy/recreate. maybe we should switch TF resource from `kubernetes_config_map` to `kubernetes_manifest` for these per-model entries so we can manage via kustomize without TF drift.
devex-bot: ping @aj for a quick PR review on the kustomize change.
aj: opening PR now — #2384. brief changelog: revert mount path, add `cfg-checksum` tagging on update, and a small `helm` value to disable secret-syncer during rollout.
maria: what about the terraform replace churn? can we patch state to avoid recreate?
simon: two options: 1) run `terraform state rm` for resource then let kustomize take ownership, 2) keep TF as owner but add `lifecycle.ignore_changes = ["data"]` (not ideal). i'm leaning to move to `kubernetes_manifest` and import the final resource. will need an apply window.
aj: timeline: I'll merge the kustomize PR on Monday morning UTC, coordinate a 15m window to pause secret-syncer job, and run a quick smoke test. if TF wants to replace, I'll hold apply and we can import.
loren: small test command to validate reload behavior locally:
```bash
kubectl exec -n inference -it deploy/flags-reloader -- /bin/sh -c '\necho new > /tmp/testfile && inotifywait -e modify /tmp/testfile\n'
```
maria: also adding a short e2e: update configmap, assert `/metrics` exposes `flags_reload_count` increment.
aj: one more thing — on the terraform side I'm going to propose a tiny example snippet in the change docs:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "model_flags_bert" {
  manifest = yamldecode(file("overlays/staging/model-flags-bert.yaml"))
}
```
simon: sounds good. @aj also add a note to oncall playbook to check `secret-syncer` logs if rollout sees spurious cm rewrites.
infra-bot: note: deploy scheduled by @aj at 2024-05-13T08:00:00Z, will create incident channel if failures > 5%.
aj: thanks all — merging in the morning and will post follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
